findings.title: A failed account read disables the explicit authentication recovery actions
findings.trigger: The connected account/read request completes with an error, for example native workspace-routing or authentication discovery failure.
findings.observedContract: accountReady requires a successful read; both perform(login/logout) and both buttons reject when it is false. The new device-login test explicitly expects login to remain disabled after a terminal read error.
findings.impact: An administrator cannot explicitly re-login or sign out to repair invalid account state; repeating the same read is the only available account action. A failed read does not itself represent an unresolved mutation.
evidence: src/runtime/service.ts: readAccount and account mutation callers
findings.recommendedFix: Permit explicit login/logout after a terminal read failure while retaining the in-flight-read, global admission, pending/unknown receipt, loginId and missing-identity guards. Do not login automatically.
findings.disposition: Confirmed by root; repair authorized after this frozen NONCLEAN report. No repair is represented as part of this snapshot.

method: Complete partition inventory with fresh changed-source and workflow reviews. Unchanged semantic review is explicitly inherited by exact byte identity; no claim of re-reading every unchanged generated line. Round1 WEB001 is preserved as nonclean; Round2 binds its independent repair review.
